This study aims to further expand this methodology to other cases that could respond to two questions: 1) to what extent does rhetoric of different illiberal actors diverge or intersect? and 2) which, if any, rhetorical patterns help constitute an illiberal discourse? Such comparison would be helpful to understand whether there is a central core in illiberal discourse and, therefore, whether we can talk about an “illiberal international” world order.
